steps: Each replica applies an operation allowed by the CRDT algebra.
Replicas exchange state or operations in any order, including duplicates.
Associative, commutative, and idempotent merge yields convergence.

production.scenario: WhatsApp reaction counters and read markers merge across phones, tablets, and desktop sessions for the same chat.
components: global mobile and desktop clients generating reactions and read state changes
service boundary that authenticates devices and batches delta sync requests
control-plane service that merges reaction and read-state deltas without coordination
durable authority in multi-region ScyllaDB for chat state and delivered deltas
delivers merged state to online devices and push queues in every region
repair path that resends missed deltas after device outages or regional failover
observability path for replica convergence lag and dropped-device backlog
flows: A device submits newly observed reactions or read markers after local user interaction.
The gateway routes the delta into the CRDT service for deterministic merge.
The convergence layer writes the merged chat state into the authoritative conversation store.
Online devices and push systems receive the converged chat projection from durable state.
Replica gaps and offline devices are identified for targeted backfill from the source of truth.
The backfill worker replays missed CRDT deltas through the same merge path before resending them.
Telemetry reports merge latency, duplicate delta rate, and backlog per shard.
